summary: This lecture continues the study of Zadul-Ma'ad, focusing on the miracles of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), with particular emphasis on the Quran as the greatest miracle. The speaker explains that while previous prophets were given miracles that compelled belief, the Quran stands as the supreme miracle given to Prophet Muhammad. The lecture discusses how the Quran has been perfectly preserved by Allah in both its wording and meanings, contrasting this with previous divine revelations that were corrupted either in their words or their interpretations by those entrusted with them.
suggested_title: The Quran as the Greatest Miracle of Prophet Muhammad - Preservation of Words and Meanings
catchy_title: Why the Quran is Islam's Greatest Miracle
